title: fix(deps): glob 14, follow-redirects 1.16.2 and joi 18.3.1 clear three of the four new OSV advisories
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XNmxDKS4SVD2ThFj2xUdpTZ)_
Part of #28292

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`glob` 从 13 升到 14.0.3（`@objectstack/metadata`、`@object-ui/cli` 两个已发布包），`follow-redirects` 升到 1.16.2、`joi` 升到 18.3.1（只改锁文件）；`@object-ui/cli` 去掉已废弃的 `@types/glob` 存根。
- **为什么改**：每日 OSV 扫描在 4 条新公告上转红；本 PR 清掉其中 3 条。第 4 条 `minimatch` 只在 11 修复，而所有父包都还不接受 11，按台账惯例要单独开豁免 PR。
- **风险与回滚**：低。两处调用点只用 `glob`/`globSync` 加 `cwd`、`ignore`、`nodir`、`absolute`，14 里没变；Node 引擎下限不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/cli/package.json`（依赖行与 `@types/glob` 删除）、`packages/metadata/package.json`、`pnpm-lock.yaml`（只动 glob、path-scurry、minimatch 11、follow-redirects、joi）。
- **两分钟验证**：`grep -E "^  (glob|follow-redirects|joi)@" pnpm-lock.yaml`，应只见 `glob@14.0.3`、`glob@7.2.3`、`follow-redirects@1.16.2`、`joi@18.3.1`。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `glob` `^13.0.6` → `^14.0.3` in the `dependencies` of `@objectstack/metadata` and `@object-ui/cli` (GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4: affected 9.0.0 to 14.0.1, fixed in 14.0.2). The lockfile moves `glob` 13.0.6 → 14.0.3, `path-scurry` 2.0.2 → 3.0.0, and adds `minimatch` 11.0.3 plus `@isaacs/nonrecursive-glob-match` 1.0.3 for glob's own copy.
- `@object-ui/cli` drops `@types/glob` 9.0.0 from `dependencies`. It is a deprecated stub ("glob provides its own type definitions") whose only content is a `glob: *` dependency, which kept `glob` 13.0.6 in the tree. `tsc --noEmit` stays green without it.
- `follow-redirects` 1.16.1 → 1.16.2 (GHSA-mrwp-f3q8-3g9p) and `joi` 18.3.0 → 18.3.1 (GHSA-4528-x5fx-h6hg): lockfile only, inside their parents' ranges (`axios`, `wait-on`). Nine lockfile lines; no other package moved. A plain `pnpm update -r follow-redirects joi` was measured first and moved unrelated packages (`@inquirer/*`, `seroval`, a driver peer set), so it was discarded; the two entries were re-resolved by pnpm alone and `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` passes on the result.
- One changeset, `patch` for both published packages.

## Why

The scheduled `Validate Dependencies` OSV scan on `main` is red on four new advisories (#28292). Triage graded it p1 because `glob` ships at runtime in two published packages, and granted a one-PR cross-domain exception for `ui/packages/cli/package.json`.

## Remainder: `minimatch` (GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249) is NOT cleared here

- Every `minimatch` before 11.0.1 is affected. 11 is a breaking major: its type surface drops `makeRe`, `AST` and two options.
- No parent's latest release accepts 11: eslint 10.14.0 (`^10.2.6`), `@eslint/config-array` 0.23.5, `@typescript-eslint/typescript-estree` 8.72.1, `@microsoft/api-extractor` 7.60.1 (exact `10.2.3`), `@oclif/core` 5.1.10, `@ts-morph/common` 0.29.0, typedoc 0.28.20 and readdir-glob all declare `^10` (glob 7.2.3 declares `^3`).
- The existing `pnpm-workspace.yaml` override that lifts every `minimatch` below 11.0.0 to `^10.2.3` already holds every copy on 10.2.6, the newest 10.x. Retargeting it to 11 would force a major outside every parent's range, which the route rules out.
- So, per the ledger's convention 3 and triage, `minimatch` needs its own `osv-exemption` PR with a dated entry. This PR adds no exemption. The seat routes that PR. Until it lands, the scheduled scan stays red on `minimatch` alone.

## Tests

Run at head `6100dd77`.

- Build: `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/metadata...' --filter '@object-ui/cli...' build` under the verify lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `@objectstack/metadata`: `vitest run`: Test Files 64 passed (64), Tests 906 passed (906). `tsc --noEmit`: exit 0. The `glob` call sites in `src/loaders/filesystem-loader.ts` (`loadMany`/`list`) are reached by the existing `filesystem-loader-*.test.ts` suites.
- `@object-ui/cli`: `vitest run packages/cli/` from `ui/`: Test Files 31 passed (31), Tests 418 passed (418). `tsc --noEmit`: exit 0. The `globSync` call sites are reached by `workspace-vite.test.ts` and the `check-*.test.ts` suites.
- The suites resolve `glob` 14.0.3 from both packages (`require('glob/package.json').version`), and the built `dist/node.cjs` and `dist/node.js` of `@objectstack/metadata` load with it.
- Lint: `eslint packages/metadata --no-inline-config` exit 0; `ui/packages/cli` `pnpm lint` exit 0 (5 pre-existing `no-explicit-any` warnings, 0 errors).

## Acceptance notes

- No new tests: the diff changes no tested behaviour, only dependency versions, and existing suites reach every call site. There is no ablation, since config is not ablated.
- `@types/glob` was in `dependencies` (not `devDependencies`) of the published `@object-ui/cli`; removing it also drops it from consumers' installs.
- The remaining `minimatch` 10.2.6 copies are not dev-only: `@objectstack/cli` ships `@oclif/core` and `ts-morph`, and `@objectstack/rest` ships `exceljs` (archiver 5 → readdir-glob / glob 7). That bears on the exemption PR's review, not on this one.

## Verification

<details><summary>OSV scan reproduction: NOT MEASURED</summary>

The OSV-Scanner binary download and `api.osv.dev` are both refused by this container's egress policy. The closest measurement is the lockfile's versions against each advisory's fixed version:

| Package | base `57f8ca2f0` | head | fixed in |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| follow-redirects | 1.16.1 | 1.16.2 | 1.16.2 |
| joi | 18.3.0 | 18.3.1 | 18.3.1 |
| glob (9 to 14.0.1 affected) | 13.0.6, 7.2.3 | 14.0.3, 7.2.3 | 14.0.2 |
| minimatch | 10.2.6 | 10.2.6, 11.0.3 | 11.0.1 |

The PR's own base-relative OSV step judges it in CI.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates: 66 derived, 65 run green, 1 NOT MEASURED</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 66 families over the 4 changed paths. 65 end with exit 0; two notes:

- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 on the shallow clone; after `git fetch --depth=1` of its pinned fixture commit it exits 0.
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: about 34 unrelated packages have no `dist/`). Narrowed locally to loading `@objectstack/metadata`'s CJS and ESM entries with `glob` 14 (both load). CI runs the full gate.

`--ran` reconciliation: `66 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 65 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`. `pnpm check:published-files` and `node scripts/check-osv-exemptions.mjs` are among the green ones.

</details>
